# The Business Partner Beside the Name — motion and channel evidence manifest

Version 2.0 · RN Collins · 7 September 2026

## Reels / TikTok / Shorts
### 0–8s — OBJ-loc-gtfy-00717
Voiceover: One frame holds a named designer, a model, a photographer, a collection, and an institutional record—separate roles that public shorthand often compresses.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

### 8–16s — B08-DIAGRAM-1
Voiceover: 01 · CAPACITY — What burden leaves the founder?. Name the decisions, relationships, records, calendars, risks, and emotional labor the partner carries. Replace “business side” with observable work and consequences.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 16–24s — B08-DIAGRAM-2
Voiceover: 02 · AUTHORITY — What may each person decide?. Write decision rights as verb plus object, threshold, required consultation, override, evidence, and appeal. Separate custom from enforceable authority.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 24–32s — B08-DIAGRAM-3
Voiceover: 03 · ECONOMICS — How are value and downside shared?. Map equity, votes, salary, royalty, bonus, expenses, guarantees, vesting, transfer, dilution, information, and exit separately. Public filings are examples, not templates.

Treatment: vertical reveal with source footer

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

### 32–40s — B08-DIAGRAM-4
Voiceover: 04 · BREAK — What happens when alignment ends?. Run deadlock, incapacity, departure, nonperformance, acquisition, founder conflict, and reputational crisis through the actual governance and contract records with qualified counsel.

Treatment: slow evidence push; no synthetic parallax

Credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins

Rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery

Voiceover: Tapestry, Inc. Form 10-K for year ended June 27, 2026 is retained as evidence, education, reporting or rights context.
